projects_design.title: School Ops Dashboard
projects_design.description: A data-heavy dashboard interface built for managing school operations, handling student records, and tracking attendance. Designed with accessibility and high information density in mind.

projects_design.title: Village Admin Portal
projects_design.description: A clean, accessible public-service UI designed to help villagers access administrative services online. Focused on clarity and ease-of-use for non-tech-savvy users.

projects_code.title: School Ops Backend
projects_code.description: The server-side engine powering the School Ops Dashboard — handling authentication, student records CRUD, attendance tracking, and report generation with native PHP and MySQL.

projects_code.title: Village Admin System
projects_code.description: Complete web system for village administration — built with PHP and JavaScript, handling document requests, citizen data management, and administrative workflows.

projects_game.title: Foliage Asset Pack Vol.1
projects_game.description: A premium collection of hand-crafted pixel-art foliage, environmental props, and world-building components for indie game developers. Available on Itch.io.

projects_game.title: Character Sticker Pack
projects_game.description: A set of expressive character stickers and sprites designed for Discord, Twitch overlays, and indie game use. Bold outlines with saturated color palettes.
